newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iranians to protest against German court decision.
newsitem.headline: Iranians to protest against German court decision.

text.p: A large number of Iranians will march to the German embassy in Tehran on Sunday to protest against a German court's verdict that Iran ordered political slayings in Berlin, state-run Tehran radio said on Saturday.
"Varied sections of Tehran's population will tomorrow (Sunday) hold a march to again reiterate Islamic values and sanctities and resistance in the face of the plots of arrogance (Western)," it said.

The radio said the demonstrators would march from Tehran university's mosque to the German embassy in protest over Thursday's verdict that Iranian leaders ordered the 1992 killings of four Kurdish dissidents in Berlin.

The ruling said that the assassinations were ordered by a secret special operations committee whose members included Iran's president, its religious leader, intelligence minister and the head of foreign policy.

But it stopped short of explicitly naming Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani and spiritual leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who prosecutors had accused of ultimate responsibility for the attack in Berlin's Mykonos restaurant.
The radio read statements by Islamist student groups and a state-affiliated labour organisation pledging wide participation of their members in the march.
Iran has repeatedly denied all involvement in the killings which it blames on infighting among opposition groups.
On Friday, hundreds of slogan-chanting Iranians pelted the German embassy in Tehran with tomatoes.
European Union (EU) members, with the exception of Greece, recalled their envoys for consultations following Thursday's verdict.
Rafsanjani on Friday criticised the verdict but said the diplomatic row was a "passing storm" provoked by the United States and Israel.
The Tehran government has urged EU states not to jeopardise their interests in Iran over the German court's decision.

Germany, until recently Iran's largest trading partner and most important Western friend, ordered four Iranian diplomats to the leave the country and recalled its ambassador in Tehran immediately after the court verdict.
Iran also recalled its ambassador and expelled four German diplomats.
